text:
maya: new model onboarding: uploaded hemlock-7b weights to s3 but need a quick sanity check before serving. weights path: s3://redwood-models/hemlock/7b/v1/ — shards look like hemlock-7b-00001-of-00008.pt. can someone confirm checksums & any extra metadata we need in the manifest?

samir: copying here — I validated the shard list and checksums (sha256) for all 8 files. manifest.json is present at the same prefix but it lacks 'vocab_size' and 'tokenizer_files' entries. uploaded a small script to fetch/check: `python infra/utils/check_shards.py --prefix s3://redwood-models/hemlock/7b/v1` :thumbsup:

jen: heads-up on tokenization: hemlock's tokenizer uses an old byte-level BPE variant. noticed URLs and email addresses are sometimes split across multiple tokens which breaks our structured output extraction (we rely on contiguous tokens for url detection). example: `https://example.com/foo-bar` -> `https://example.com/` + `foo` + `-bar`. this trips the golden prompt that expects a single token span for the url.

alex: is that the same issue we saw with t5x-derived vocabs? if so we should set a post-tokenize merge step in the eval pipeline, or prefer a tokenizer config option like `add_prefix_space` / `normalize_spaces`. what does manifest suggest?

samir: manifest currently only lists `tokenizer_type: bpe` and `tokenizer_json: tokenizer.json` (no extra config flags). i can add `eos_id` and `pad_id` if we want. also noticed `max_seq_length` in the model_config is 2048 but our serving config default is 1024 — that mismatch will cause truncation in routing and might break structured outputs. recommend aligning serving config to 2048 for the canary.

maya: ok so action items: (1) jen to make a tokenizer shim or config patch to normalize url/email tokenization during evals and serve tests, (2) samir to update manifest with vocab/tokenizer metadata + eos/pad ids, (3) alex to bump canary serving config to 2048 and run smoke tool-calls. i'll own the canary rollout once those are green.

jen: I'll put up a tiny PR to the tokenizer adapter — plan: after tokenization run a regex-based re-merge step for common url/email patterns, gated behind a flag `--postmerge-urls`. We'll add a unit test and a small golden prompt to catch regressions. ETA EOD tomorrow.

ci-bot: regression/tests/toolcall-integration failed on branch `canary/hemlock-7b` — failure log: `ToolSchemaMismatch: expected tool 'web_search' args (query:string) got (q:string)` — looks like the tool-calling schema in the model output differs. Turning on strict tool schema check for canaries temporarily.

alex: that schema mismatch is likely from the model's structured output spec: `tool_call` fields in the sample outputs are `name` + `params` (freeform) instead of the strict `name` + typed `args`. we should add a simple mapping layer in the router that normalizes `params->args` and validates against our tool registry before hitting CI. would avoid failing downstream.

qa-bot: recommend adding these golden prompts to the regression suite before canary: 1) url/email extraction (single-span), 2) toolcall with typed args (web_search with query:string), 3) structured JSON output with `items[]` length assertions. I pushed a new eval job template `hemlock-7b-smoke` to the eval queue: https://evals.redwood.ai/jobs/1820 

maya: thanks all. jen + samir please ping here when PRs/manifest updates are up. alex i'll coordinate the serving config change with infra. ci-bot / qa-bot thanks for the test catches — will wait for smoke eval results before canary rollout. :rocket:

samir: pushed manifest patch `manifest+tokenizer_meta` and attached checksums in S3 metadata. left a comment with the s3 copy command and verification steps.

jen: opened PR #412 in model-utils with `postmerge-urls` flag + unit tests. included example failing tokenization case in test data. requesting review from @alex @maya.

alex: reviewing now. one quick note: update the serving fallback policy to prefer `hemlock-7b-quant` variant if latency >200ms during the canary. will add that to the canary config.

maya: perfect. once PRs merge i'll trigger canary and loop in support. cheers.
